english.title: Employer fail to keep records to establish employee remuneration at least equal to agricultural minimum rate
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being an employer of a worker who qualified for the agricultural minimum rate of wages, failed to keep in respect of that worker, for a period of six years beginning with the day upon which the pay reference period immediately following that to which they related ended, sufficient records to establish that you were remunerating

(A)_[him,]_
(B)_[her,]_

at a rate at least equal to the applicable agricultural minimum rate of wages in a form which enabled the information kept about that worker in respect of a pay reference period to be produced in a single document
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 59(5), (7) and (8) of the National Minimum Wage Regulations 2015 and section 31(2) and (9) of the National Minimum Wage Act 1998.
english.pointstoprove:

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
